name: test-report-sharing
description: Collect test reports into a static site for local preview or ngrok sharing.

interface.shortDescription: Preview existing test reports locally or share a public URL.
interface.longDescription: Collects existing test reports into a browsable static site. The skill uses local previews unless public sharing is requested; report collection does not rerun tests.
defaultPrompt: Collect existing test reports and show a local preview.
Share the existing test reports through a public URL.
